activity_summary: You took the bay at first light. The hire is twelvepence a day and his fodder, and you paid none of it this morning. The ostler's paper said seven. You left at the sky you had.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Took the bay, refused a second look at the teeth, and paid nothing.

entities.name: 12d a day and fodder
entities.context: Mentioned in The bay, as bespoken

facets.activity: Took the bay bespoken on the seventeenth

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I'll not pretend to judge his teeth a second time.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: The horse leaves now. The paper can keep its hour.
